many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the two equal-width symbol panels; keep cells occupied in both."""
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    # The vertical 5-valued bar divides the two panels.
    separators = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(h))]
    if not separators:
        raise ValueError("separator column not found")
    sep = separators[0]
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    if any(len(a) != len(b) for a, b in zip(left, right)):
        raise ValueError("panels are not equal width")
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(l, r)]
            for l, r in zip(left, right)]
"
